_doc: Bundle order for the client build. Paths are relative to atlas/. Files in 'optional' may be missing (build.py warns); the PPA module (core/js/ppa.js, core/css/ppa.css) is required. Never list anything under investor/ here: build.py fails the client build if you do. The shared skin ("product": skins/product/skin-product.css and .js) comes last among the CSS and right before core/js/app.js among the JS; it only acts when template.html sets data-skin="product"; remove both lines and that attribute to get the core look back. The "brand" block (build.py brand_assets) gives the client its RenewaBlox favicon (the BLOX. roundel), its web fonts (Open Sans, the fallback for the brand face Leelawadee UI) and the official wordmarks as CSS custom properties; see atlas/brand/README.md.
